Nora (People Ops): Quick heads-up: auditors asked for a split-by-lane upload cadence for SOC2/ISO evidence. We're doing staggered handovers over May to reduce review bottlenecks. Please update your team's evidence owner in the Confluence table by tomorrow EOD. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/2026-audit-window
Ethan (Security): Thanks. Does this change what artifacts are required or just when we hand them over?
Nora (People Ops): Timing only. Same checklist. The schedule just spaces teams so reviewers can do deeper checks without a big surge.
Sam (Infra): Can you post the lane assignments here so small teams can coordinate cross-owners?
Nora (People Ops): Lane summary: A (week 2026-05-04): Runtime/Serving; B (week 2026-05-11): Platform/SRE/Observability; C (week 2026-05-18): SDKs/DevEx/Docs; D (week 2026-05-25): GTM (sales/support) - controls only.
Priya (Legal): Reminder: redact any PII or customer-identifying info per the redaction checklist before upload. Legal will spot-check samples. If you need redaction help, ping legal-help.
Sam (Infra): Evidence owner for Platform: Sam L. I'll upload runbooks, access lists, and recent deployment logs. Preferred formats?
Nora (People Ops): PDFs for policies, CSV manifests for inventories. Large logs: zip into <500MB chunks, include README and SHA256 hash. Use tag `evidence_2026_<lane>_<team>` on uploads.
Ethan (Security): Security will review Lane A/B bundles and add a KV/secret-handling checklist to the manifest template.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-28 09:00 UTC: "Confirm evidence owner in Confluence"
Nora (People Ops): We'll run a 20-min drop-in office hours on 2026-04-29 16:00 UTC for upload questions; recording posted to the Confluence page. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
